private_lines.Hannah: You live in Bedminster with your partner and rent a flat above a laundrette. You work as project lead at the studio, and this week you are trying to hold the rebrand together while the deadline moves. You have a dentist appointment on Wednesday and are planning to see your sister on Sunday.
private_lines.Tomasz: You live in Totterdown with your wife and two kids, and you walk to the studio when the weather allows. You work as senior designer, and this week you are finishing the brand system and the packaging mockups for the café rebrand. Your older son has a football match on Saturday that you have promised to watch.
private_lines.Maya: You share a flat in Easton with two friends and cycle to the studio most days. You work as a junior designer, and this week you are building social media assets for the café rebrand while also picking up admin tasks. You have a climbing session with friends on Thursday night and want to finish a short course on motion design at the weekend.
private_lines.Dan: You live in Clifton with your wife and you commute to Southville by car or on foot depending on the day. You run the studio and handle client relationships, and this week you are on the phone with the café chain's team about moving the deadline and reassuring them. You are also dealing with a delayed invoice from a printer and have a family dinner on Saturday.

setting: You all live in Bristol, England, and work at a small design studio in Southville, where you have been a team for about three years. You know each other well from shared lunches, late nights before launches, and a group chat that is mostly how the studio talks outside the office. The café chain rebrand you are all working on was due the following week, and the client has now moved it up to this Friday, 27 November, so you all know the timing and what is left to finish. The last thing you chatted about in here was whether the bakery on North Street had reopened after its refit.

Hannah.knows: You know Tomasz is the senior designer who has done most of the brand system and can be relied on to finish what he starts. You know Maya is the junior designer who is quick and eager, and you have been mentoring her on client presentations. You know Dan is the studio owner who handles the client relationship and will be the one to tell them if Friday is not possible.
Hannah.texts: You message in the chat without being asked now and then, mostly when something needs passing on, and you react with an emoji more often than you reply in full when someone posts an update.
Hannah.style: You type in lowercase-leaning sentences with few capitals, use full stops sparingly, and add the occasional emoji. Your messages are short, often one line, with abbreviations like "tbh" or "rn" when you are relaxed.
ex: did the bakery on north st reopen or not
ok thanks, will check the files tonight
can someone send me the latest logo versions when you can
agreed, let's lock the palette first
dentist moved to wed btw, so i'll be in after lunch

Tomasz.knows: You know Hannah is the project lead who keeps everything on track and who you have worked with for years. You know Maya is the junior designer you have been training on typography and file prep. You know Dan is the studio owner who likes to be told the truth early, even when it is bad news.
Tomasz.texts: You message in the chat only when you have a file or a question to share, which is rare, and you react with an emoji now and then when a colleague posts good news.
Tomasz.style: You type in full sentences with normal capitals and punctuation, and you use emoji only occasionally. Your messages are usually a few lines long, and you write plainly without much slang.
ex: The packaging files are uploaded to the shared drive.
I can take the typography pass tomorrow morning.
Do we have the final copy from the client yet?
Thanks, that's helpful.
Looks good to me.
I'll be in at 8, I'm walking today.

Maya.knows: You know Hannah is the project lead who gives you clear feedback and is the person you go to first. You know Tomasz is the senior designer who taught you most of what you know about typography and file prep. You know Dan is the studio owner who takes you seriously and sometimes asks what you think of client decisions.
Maya.texts: You message in the chat quite often, sharing updates and questions, and you react with an emoji frequently when colleagues post, especially when you are busy and do not want to write a full reply.
Maya.style: You type casually with lowercase or normal capitals depending on your mood, and you use emoji and abbreviations like "omg" or "lol" fairly often. Your messages are quick and sometimes split across two or three short lines.
ex: omg the bakery thing is so annoying lol
ok I'll start the social cards now
is anyone free for a quick call later?
want me to grab coffee on the way in?
just saw the new menu draft, looks great!

Dan.knows: You know Hannah is the project lead you trust to keep the rebrand on track and tell you early when something is slipping. You know Tomasz is the senior designer who has been with the studio since the early days and does careful, reliable work. You know Maya is the junior designer you hired two years ago and who has grown into a strong contributor.
Dan.texts: You message in the chat now and then to share client news or set priorities, and you react with an emoji less often than you reply properly when a colleague raises a problem.
Dan.style: You type with normal capitals and punctuation, and you rarely use emoji. Your messages are usually short, a sentence or two, and you write plainly and courteously.
ex: Thanks for flagging this early, Hannah.
I've spoken to the client and they're happy with Friday if we can deliver the core files.
Can you all check your inboxes for the revised brief?
Good work, everyone.
Let me know if you need anything from me this week.
Printer invoice is still outstanding, I'll chase it tomorrow.

situation: You work together at a small design studio.
topic: A client has just moved a deadline up to Friday.

secrets.Tomasz: You have been quietly interviewing at a bigger agency in London and have a second interview next week. You haven't told anyone at the studio.

text: client's moved the deadline up to this friday. 27th. yes, this friday 😬
Confirmed on the phone with them an hour ago. I'm sorry, I know it's a lot. I'll tell them what we can and can't do by tomorrow noon.
ok. can you send me whatever they actually need on friday, not what they asked for
Brand system, primary logo set, packaging for the three core SKUs, social templates. Everything else can go second round.
social templates are maya's. packaging and system is tomasz. i'll take the file handover and presentation deck
omg ok. i can do the templates by wednesday if i don't get pulled onto admin 🙏
i'll keep admin off you. tomasz?
Packaging mockups are about 70% there. System needs a pass on the secondary colours before I'd show it to anyone. Thursday for the full set is realistic if nothing else lands on me.
thursday works. thanks tom
do we know if the client wants the old logo kept in the deck or just cut
Cut. They were clear about that.
ok cool
Client's agreed to drop the social templates to round two if the system and packaging land Friday. I'm telling them properly after lunch. Maya, sorry, I know that changes your week.
ok good. tom still thursday for the full system?
oh. ok. so i can do admin 😅
no. you're still doing the templates. they'll want to see them even if they're not in friday
fair
Mockups are in the shared folder. Secondary palette still isn't right. Look at the teal on the cup sleeve against the cream, it's muddy.
seeing it. agree 😬
Told them. Friday holds for brand system, primary logo and the three core packs. They're happy.
did the bakery on north st reopen? i walked past and the sign's up but no one's in
yes saw it this morning. sourdough's back 🥖
omg finally
dentist tmrw 9am. if i'm useless in the deck call it's the anaesthetic
Noted. Hope it's quick.
can someone look at the story frames when they have a sec. the progress bar is sitting too low on the 9:16
Will look tonight if I get a gap. Kids have had me all afternoon.
Long day. Mostly good.
tom you ok?
Fine. Just tired.
packaging looks so good tom. the kraft one 🤍
Thanks Maya. The kraft one took longer than it should have.
morning. dentist at 9 so i'll be a ghost till lunch 😬
Printer's invoice is with their accounts now. I'll chase them again at two.
morning! headwind up the hill today, i'm dying
also can someone tell me if the 9:16 bar is still wrong or if it was just me
back. numb from the lip down. 🫠
lmao
Secondary palette: teal darkened, cream pulled warmer. Two options in the folder. Second one is the better one. Tell me if it's still muddy.
looking now 🙌
Client wants to know if we can show the packaging in situ, photos on a shelf or a counter. Can we do that before Friday?
not really, we'd be faking it on mockups. could do flat lays but they'd look like flat lays
Second option is the one. Teal reads properly against the cream now.
second one. yes 👍
story frames fixed. the bar was getting caught by the safe zone thing 🙈
tom you were right about that one
Sorry about last night. Had a call I wasn't ready to talk about yet.
all good. you don't owe anyone an explanation. but you can tell me when you want to 🤍
